selection.name: Fury Swipes
selection.description: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage. If the same target is not attacked after 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +12 Fury Swipes stack damage, debuff now lasts for the duration of the round.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Every 2 attacks on an enemy applies 1 stack to all other enemies.

selection.name: Gaben's Strength
selection.description: The hero channels their rogue strength, granting bonus damage for a duration.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Gaben's Strength also grants spell immunity for 4 seconds.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: For every 500 damage accumulated from attacking while in Gaben's Strength, a Storm Bolt is hurled towards the hero's target (3s cooldown).

selection.name: Ghostship
selection.description: Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage. Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a swig of The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to incoming damage.
selection.differences: Has reduced damage, and damage reduction scales per level.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Creates a Tidal Wave upon crashing, knocking enemies towards the enemy team. +10% damage reduction.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Summons 2 more ships after the first, each arriving 3.5 seconds after the previous.

selection.name: Glaives of Wisdom
selection.description: The hero enchants their attacks with their wisdom, dealing additional damage based on their Intelligence. The hero temporarily steals their target's Intelligence with each hit.
selection.differences: Does not steal Intelligence permanently until Super.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Permanently gains +2 intelligence when an enemy dies within 925 radius of this hero.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Glaives bounce once, dealing 50% attack damage. +15% intelligence to damage.

selection.name: Global Silence
selection.description: The hero stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Applies Curse of the Silent to all affected enemies.
